recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy or FHIR-I resolves FHIR-54374 or FHIR-55418 with a new R6 change to remove, retarget, or further rationalize MedicationDispense.partOf.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R4 Pharmacy change request asking for MedicationDispense.partOf to be better explained, questioning why it was 0..* and limited to Procedure. The approved resolution kept 0..*, added MedicationAdministration as a target, and explained that a Procedure and a MedicationAdministration could both trigger a dispense, while multiple procedures or multiple administrations were not expected.
initial_application: Commit 603de50396973db754fec17786a66ce29799296c applied FHIR-26894 to medicationdispense-spreadsheet.xml by changing partOf from Reference(Procedure) to Reference(Procedure | MedicationAdministration), updating the definition, and adding the cardinality rationale as a comment. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 migrated that applied content into structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. The current structure definition and Event-pattern mapping exception source both preserve the Procedure and MedicationAdministration targets and rationale text. A May 2020 Zulip thread about grouping dispenses pointed to Encounter/context and did not conflict with the issue resolution. Later R6 issues FHIR-54374 and FHIR-55418 question this element, but they remain Triaged/Submitted and unresolved, so they are background only.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current build-scope source already satisfies the published decision. Editing now would be editorial only or would anticipate unresolved R6 work-group decisions.
